issue.title: Past-offset Pomodoro starts after midnight write yesterday's time into today's note (=-3 x at 00:05 → 2350-0005)

task_type_fields.impact: Silent misdating of ledger history. Stats' date-aware coordinates read a wrapped `2350-0005` row in today's note as tonight 23:50→00:05 tomorrow, so worked minutes land on the wrong evening. That can also produce false `clock_overlap` health warnings against tonight's real sessions. Only captures in the first minutes after midnight that use an offset start are affected.
task_type_fields.repro:
On a scratch vault with today's note `2026/20261104.md` whose `## Pomodoros` holds an open `- [ ] () — FIX` placeholder:

```bash
BOB_DAY_FILE=<vault>/2026/20261104.md BOB_NOW="2026-11-04 00:05:00" \
  bob capture -b <vault> -- '=-3 x'
```

prints `started FIX 2350-0015 (25m)` then `closed FIX 2350-0015 → 2350-0005 (15m, −10m)` and writes `- [x] (**2350-0005** [t:: 15m]) — FIX` into the 2026-11-04 note. That session actually started at 23:50 on 2026-11-03. Reproduced on master d216f7eb (grammar 10).

Root cause: `compute_pomodoro_start_range` (src/native/capture/pomodoro_start.rs:14) takes `start_block_minute` (src/native/capture/meet_event_run.rs:200), which can be negative when `now − 5·offset` crosses midnight, and formats it modulo 1440 instead of refusing. Every past-offset start (`=N-M`, `=name@N-M`, link starts with `=N-M`) is affected. Likely fix: refuse a start whose block minute is negative, with a teaching error naming the largest offset that stays on today (the same rule proposed for `x=` in research:202611/past_pomodoro_x_equals__cld.md §A7).

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying x= past-Pomodoro research: offset starts crossing midnight wrap modulo 1440 into today's ledger instead of refusing, silently misdating history.
